description: Modeled expected outcomes from verified org claims scaled by gift_usd. Always modeled:true and guaranteed:false. Never invents CE; returns insufficient_data when no usable verified unit. Each outcome carries say_as, rounded to two significant figures (say this to the donor); expected_value keeps the exact arithmetic. Answers carry decision_brief: the charity's own donate_url (next_action), the evaluator's fund as a let-the-evaluator-choose alternative, the like-for-like comparison page when one exists, and modeled: true / guaranteed: false when figures are present. No figure, rating or order is added.
